concept: PrivateLink: NLB-backed endpoint service for access from other VPCs
tests: How to privately expose a single service to consumers in other VPCs/accounts without peering or the internet.
expected: AWS PrivateLink: an endpoint service behind a Network Load Balancer; consumers create interface endpoints. Works with overlapping CIDRs. Triggers: "expose a service", "other VPCs and accounts", "without VPC peering", "not exposed to internet".
why_not: Transit Gateway connects whole networks rather than exposing one service; a public ALB exposes it to the internet; peering with every VPC doesn't scale and opens the whole network.
